description: This file defines functions and types for managing LINE rich menus, including creation, uploading images, linking/unlinking to users, and layout creation. It also exports some action functions and default menu configuration.

classes.name: RichMenuSize
classes.description: Defines the size of a rich menu with width and height.

classes.name: RichMenuAreaRequest
classes.description: Defines an area within a rich menu with bounds and an associated action.

classes.name: CreateRichMenuParams
classes.description: Parameters for creating a rich menu, including size, name, chat bar text, and areas.

classes.name: RichMenuOpts
classes.description: Options for rich menu operations, including channel access token, account ID, and verbosity.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Creates a messaging API client using provided options.

methods.name: getBlobClient
methods.description: Creates a blob client for uploading images.

methods.name: chunkUserIds
methods.description: Splits a list of user IDs into batches of size USER_BATCH_SIZE.
